user.title: Select paired remote
user.description: Pair your remote outside this integration first. ATVV indicates a cached voice service; wake to check means capabilities have not been verified.

configure.description: Wake the remote with an arrow button before submitting. Starts in transcription-only mode.

init.title: Voice settings
init.description: Select any Assist pipeline. Automatic output streams when supported. Replacing a request cannot undo actions already performed. Conversation while held alternates listening and replies; simultaneous full duplex is unavailable. Stopping after transcription does not disable tools embedded in a live speech provider. Use a transcription-only provider when actions must be disabled.
